The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `7233` (see `TemporalBuilder.TemporalGrpcPort`)
- Port: `8233` (see `TemporalBuilder.TemporalHttpPort`)
- Command: `server start-dev --ip 0.0.0.0`
- Wait strategy: Waits until the TCP port `7233` is available from the test host to the container.
- Wait strategy: Waits until the TCP port `8233` is available from the test host to the container.
- Wait strategy: Waits until the HTTP request `GET /api/v1/system-info` to port `8233` is completed successfully.
